common: Neutral standard accent. Studio-quality voice-over recording: dry, close microphone, no room echo, no reverb, no background noise.

characters.name: Hero
characters.description: Young man, about 18. Light, bright tenor, clearly higher than an average male voice. Sincere, slightly naive and awkward, stammers when nervous but can sound heroic. Animated adventure protagonist with good comic timing.
characters.text: [confidently] No. I will come back, I promise. [nervous] W-what was that? [shouts] Stop, you are not getting past me! [voice trembling] But I told them everything would be fine…

characters.name: Rival
characters.description: Man in his forties. Deep, gravelly baritone with theatrical pride. Enjoys his own speeches, turns quickly from smug to furious. Animated fantasy villain with a touch of comedy.
characters.text: [proud, theatrical] You stand before the one the whole north fears! [amused] Did you really decide to stop me? [shouts, mad] I will grind you to dust! [scared] Th-this is impossible…
